# Alpha.4 fixture matrix

The machine-readable matrix is `fixtures/alpha4/fixture-matrix.json`.

| Scenario | Expected behavior |
|---|---|
| Legacy alpha.3 profile | Schema-valid; `legacy-unprojected`; no invented profile structure claims |
| Routine private change | `none`; no standalone structure reviewer |
| Public typed package API | Projection plus API/typing guidance and focused review for review roles |
| External JSON boundary | Runtime validation remains separate from annotations |
| asyncio cancellation | Task/resource ownership and failure review |
| Multiprocessing handoff | Process message, start method and worker lifecycle evidence |
| Plugin entry point | Installed entry-point consumer touchpoint |
| Package artifact | Clean wheel/sdist-derived consumer slice |
| Migration | Structure, recovery, evidence and compatibility treatment |
| Broad survey | Does not fan out every structure specialist |
| Unsupported procedure | Bounded `UNSUPPORTED`, no invented Python claim |
| Missing alpha.4 validator | `BLOCKED_INPUT`, not silently skipped |
| Harmless private difference | Advisory only; no material conformance failure |
| Public import fixed-decision drift | `MATERIAL_DIVERGENCE` naming the exact decision |
| Async owner drift | `MATERIAL_DIVERGENCE` naming fixed and ownership references |
| Foundation exception | Allowed only with its own touchpoint and named next integrated slice |
